findings.title: Align the dependency overrides with the Spring Boot platform
findings.trigger: Build the candidate with the committed Spring Boot 3.3.4 dependency management, then initialize Jackson or Hibernate Validator.
findings.baseline: Jackson 2.17.2 reads JSON successfully. Compatible cached Validator 8.0.2 initializes with the managed API/logging dependencies.
findings.candidate: Databind 2.21.8 fails ObjectMapper initialization with NoClassDefFoundError JsonSerializeAs. Validator 9.0.2 fails provider initialization with NoSuchMethodError Logger.getMessageLogger(MethodHandles.Lookup,Class,String).
findings.cause: Only databind and validator versions change. The parent still manages Jackson core/annotations at 2.17.2, Jakarta validation at 3.0.2, and JBoss Logging at 3.5.3.Final.
findings.consequence: JSON mapper initialization cannot complete. The service cannot initialize its JSON HTTP infrastructure under this committed dependency closure. Validator initialization independently fails.
findings.next_action: Choose a compatible dependency set and align each related dependency through its supported BOM. Verify the actual service startup and full owning Maven suite.
findings.confidence: high for the actual dependency linkage errors; source-inferred BFF startup consequence
limits: Actual BFF startup remains blocked by unavailable private starter and build dependencies.
Validator baseline substitutes cached 8.0.2.Final for Boot-managed 8.0.1.Final. Jackson baseline and candidate override are exact.
No live service or deployment was exercised.

shared_rollout_findings_delegated.behavior: One failed CES application aborts the complete readEms3 aggregate. Dual mode retains only EMS2 grants. EMS3_ONLY propagates the failure through authentication.
shared_rollout_findings_delegated.status: source-confirmed; runtime evidence owned by parallel probe

other_observations.reason: Local source declares only one Executor bean. No ambiguous reachable injection was established. Do not flag field annotation placement alone.
The unchanged bare RestTemplate has no configured timeout. The new aggregate waits with future.join on the shared four-worker executor. No stalled-service execution was performed.

other_observations.topic: Boot 4 RestTemplate imports in a Boot 3 parent
other_observations.reason: AuthConfig imports the same Boot 4 namespaces at main and candidate.
Service and mapper reject empty role_entitlements; existing tests explicitly assert rejection. Whether a live zero-assignment response uses this shape needs provider evidence.

validation_limits.reason: The local Maven cache lacks maven-help-plugin. No dependencies were downloaded and no lifecycle build ran.

validation_limits: Current source mapper/routing tests run by parallel agent use a controlled dependency closure. They do not validate the committed POM overrides.
